name: export-problems-to-markdown
description: Export all diagnostics from the Problems panel (errors, warnings, info, hints) to a grouped Markdown file.

exportProblems.minimumSeverity.description: Minimum diagnostic severity to include in the export (Hint includes everything, Error includes only errors).

enumDescriptions: One section per file, listing that file's diagnostics.
One section per severity (Errors, Warnings, ...), listing affected files.
A single Markdown table with one row per diagnostic.
exportProblems.groupBy.description: How diagnostics are organized in the exported Markdown.

exportProblems.includeSummary.description: Include the summary header block at the top of the export.

exportProblems.summaryTitle.description: H1 title used when the summary is included.

exportProblems.includeExportDate.description: Include the generation timestamp in the summary.

exportProblems.includeProblemCount.description: Include the total problem and file count in the summary.

exportProblems.includeSource.description: Include the source and code tag (e.g. [eslint, no-unused-vars]) for each diagnostic.

exportProblems.includeColumn.description: Include the column number in locations (Line 42:8 vs Line 42).

exportProblems.defaultFileName.description: Default file name used in the save dialog and for the 'workspace-file' output mode.

enumDescriptions: Prompt with a native save dialog each time.
Silently write to a validated file beneath the local workspace; otherwise prompt with a save dialog.
Copy the Markdown to the clipboard instead of writing a file.
exportProblems.outputMode.description: Where the exported Markdown is written. Workspace-file mode prompts for confirmation when the configured target cannot be proven safe.

exportProblems.openAfterExport.description: Open the exported file in the editor after writing it (ignored for the 'clipboard' output mode).

scripts.test: npm run compile && npm run compile:test && node --test .test-out/test/exportErrors.test.js .test-out/test/exportProblemsToMarkdown.test.js .test-out/test/workspacePathSecurity.test.js .test-out/test/extensionContract.test.js .test-out/test/configurationFallbacks.test.js .test-out/test/outputTargets.test.js
